paragraphs.source_en: A light gradually came into Nobuchika’s eyes. At last, he seemed to understand the true meaning of renouncing the world. “Would Zuifū take me as his disciple?”

units.source_en: A light gradually came into Nobuchika’s eyes.
units.source_zh: 信近的眼里渐渐有了光彩。

units.source_en: At last, he seemed to understand the true meaning of renouncing the world.
units.source_zh: 他似乎终于明白了出家的真意。

units.source_en: “Would Zuifū take me as his disciple?”

ja.t: にしてくださるのですか」

paragraphs.source_zh: 信近的眼里渐渐有了光彩。他似乎终于明白了出家的真意。“随风愿意收我为徒？”

paragraphs.source_en: “There is no question of disciple or master. We shall simply wander through the provinces like the wind. Everyone living in hell longs for paradise. Once you shave your head, even those who once kept their doors shut to visitors will receive you in the name of reverence for the Buddha… Ha, ha! This, too, is part of Zuifū’s strategy.”

units.source_en: “There is no question of disciple or master.
We shall simply wander through the provinces like the wind.
units.source_zh: 只是像风一样游历诸国。

units.source_en: Everyone living in hell longs for paradise.
units.source_zh: 生活在地狱中的每一个人都向往极乐。

units.source_en: Once you shave your head, even those who once kept their doors shut to visitors will receive you in the name of reverence for the Buddha… Ha, ha! This, too, is part of Zuifū’s strategy.”
units.source_zh: 只要你剃了头发，那些以前闭门不见客的人也会以礼佛的名义见你⋯⋯哈哈，这也是随风的策谋。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “无所谓弟子和师父。只是像风一样游历诸国。生活在地狱中的每一个人都向往极乐。只要你剃了头发，那些以前闭门不见客的人也会以礼佛的名义见你⋯⋯哈哈，这也是随风的策谋。”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuchika bowed his head to Hatarō. “Thank you! Then tomorrow, Nobuchika will go with Master Zuifū…”

units.source_en: Nobuchika bowed his head to Hatarō.
units.source_zh: 信近低头向波太郎施了一礼。

units.source_en: Then tomorrow, Nobuchika will go with Master Zuifū…”
units.source_zh: 那明日信近就和随风师父一起⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信近低头向波太郎施了一礼。“多谢！那明日信近就和随风师父一起⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_en: When Hatarō awoke the next morning, Nobuchika and Ashun were already gone from the room. It seemed that the two of them had chosen that one thing alone: “love.”

units.source_en: When Hatarō awoke the next morning, Nobuchika and Ashun were already gone from the room.
units.source_zh: 第二日晨，波太郎醒来时，信近和阿俊都已经不在房间里了。

units.source_en: It seemed that the two of them had chosen that one thing alone: “love.”
units.source_zh: 他们二人似乎单单选择了一个“情”字。

paragraphs.source_zh: 第二日晨，波太郎醒来时，信近和阿俊都已经不在房间里了。他们二人似乎单单选择了一个“情”字。
